description: Ham2K Logger extension: Silos on the Air

//devDependencies: The libraries the host carries are DECLARED in manifest.json and rewritten
to the host's instance at build time, so the bundle needs none of them
installed. The unit tests do: `node --test` runs the source as it is, with
Node's own resolver, so every bare specifier it reaches has to be on disk.
These are the ones this extension's own tests reach through the SDK.
